other_failure_modes.name: Test feature destruction via independent constant filtering
other_failure_modes.description: Dropping constant features independently on the test set causes valid features that happen to be constant in the test split to be dropped. When aligned with the train set later, these dropped features are replaced entirely with NaNs, destroying valid test information.

summary: The agent implements a generally sound LightGBM pipeline with robust 5-fold cross-validation and early stopping. However, the solution lacks feature engineering, uses only accuracy without verifying class balance, and critically corrupts the test set by independently dropping features that happen to be constant in the test split before alignment.
